title: 总结：Android 内存专家知识图谱
key_conclusions: The full curriculum reduces to a repeatable chain: symptom, bucket, evidence, owner, source boundary, fix, replay, and release decision.
Android memory expertise requires joining ART, framework lifecycle, native, graphics, kernel reclaim, ZRAM, lmkd, tooling, and release gates.
Timestamped evidence is the difference between plausible memory stories and defensible engineering conclusions.
The plan is complete, but future improvement should focus on real sample artifacts, automation, thresholds, and source validation.
shallow_points: The final map summarizes the curriculum but does not attach real sample artifacts.
It does not implement automation for timeline alignment, owner mapping, or review CI.
It does not define numeric RAM-class thresholds for every release gate.
It does not validate every source path against local AOSP tags and vendor kernels.
discovered_connections: Day 79's release-gate mindset becomes the final output boundary for all technical diagnosis.
Day 73's symptom-to-evidence-to-source-to-fix loop becomes the master knowledge graph.
Days 77 and 78 show why timestamped low-end evidence is essential for Bitmap, PSI, ZRAM, and lmkd reasoning.
The whole 80-day plan forms one ladder from runtime fundamentals to production review gates.
suggest_future_topics: Build a real sample artifact library containing HPROF, Perfetto, lmkd, PSI, zram, vmstat, showmap, and heapprofd data.
Create an automated timeline tool that aligns meminfo, vmstat, PSI, logcat, and Perfetto timestamps.
Create RAM-class-specific memory review thresholds for release gates.
Validate the source-path map against concrete AOSP tags, kernels, and vendor ROMs.
knowledge_gaps: Need real device artifacts for each major diagnostic path.
Need automation that generates reports from raw evidence.
Need source validation across Android releases, target SDK boundaries, kernels, and vendor ROMs.
Need production dashboards and CI examples to enforce the review checklist.
applied_reflections: Applied Day 79's next-run instruction by building the final Android memory expert knowledge map.
Applied Day 79's release-gate mindset by ending every path at validation and release decision gates.
Applied Day 73's symptom-to-evidence-to-source-to-fix loop as the master structure for the final article.
Applied the standing more-diagrams-less-prose feedback by using four Mermaid diagrams, compact matrices, source maps, gate tables, and checklists.
visible_changes: Added four Mermaid diagrams because of the more-diagrams-less-prose feedback: total knowledge graph, symptom-to-evidence path, fix selection graph, and final expert chain.
Added tables for capability layers, symptom evidence, source-reading entries, good/bad fixes, release gates, future construction, and conclusions.
Added a final checklist that compresses the 80-day method into reusable field practice.
next_run_instructions: The 80-day plan is complete; do not generate Day 81 unless the curriculum is explicitly extended.
Future runs should focus on optional appendices, real sample artifacts, automation, source validation, or review CI only if requested.
If GitHub Issues still cannot be read, keep recording the gh auth login or GH_TOKEN blocker in automation memory.
